ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II Intel LGA1700 DDR5 mATX Motherboard – Built for Gaming Performance and Durability

Experience unmatched reliability and performance with the ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II, a micro-ATX motherboard engineered for Intel’s 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen Core processors (LGA1700). Designed for gamers and performance PC builders, this B760 chipset motherboard supports DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0 graphics cards, and triple M.2 storage, making it ideal for high-speed gaming and multitasking.

  • Compatible with Intel LGA1700 CPUs (12th, 13th, 14th Gen)
  • Supports DDR5 RAM up to 192GB, up to 7800 MHz (OC)
  • PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for next-gen GPUs
  • 3x M.2 slots and 4x SATA ports for ultra-fast storage
  • Realtek 2.5Gb LAN for low-latency online gaming
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen 2, and Gen 1 ports
  • Premium audio with Realtek 7.1-channel codec and DTS support
  • Reinforced components with TUF military-grade durability
  • Customizable RGB lighting with Aura Sync support

This motherboard is perfect for building a powerful gaming PC in a compact mATX case, offering advanced thermal management, fast connectivity, and stable power delivery. Ideal for gamers, streamers, and creators seeking performance and reliability at a great value.
